bodyText: ChangelogTwitterAbout usWe're hiring!Sign inLinear - limited beta releaseThe issue trackingtool you'll enjoy usingLinear helps streamline software projects, sprints, tasks, and bug tracking. It's built for high-performance teams.Request Early AccessPowering next-gen companiesThe speed teams needBuilt to be lightning fastWith Linear, you get the kind of experience you’d expect from a professional tool. Everything is synchronized in real-time across your entire organization. No loaders, no spinners, no waiting.< 100msBuilt for speedNo page loads. Instant search. Realtime sync.Use the keyboard for everythingOptimized for efficiency with extensive keyboard shortcuts.Prioritization, labelsSupports both Kanban boards and list views.Offline supportAccess and make changes with or without internet access.Dark modeLight or dark, your choice.Multiple teamsCompany growing? Manage issues for multiple teams.Less managing, more meaningRobust issue creation. Create and assign new issues in seconds with the markdown editor.List and board view. See your issues, sprint or project either in a list or Kanban board view.Flexible workflow states. Maintain a backlog and track issue progress across configurable issue states.⌘KMeet your command lineYour work is about to get way more efficient. Any action can be accessed and completed in seconds with the command menu.Integrated workflow designed for product teamsLinear keeps everyone aligned and working more efficiently. Engineers, designers, and peers – all collaborating in one tool.Design with FigmaAdd Figma links to any issue or comment as you work on your designs and Linear will automatically create and embed a preview.Full Figma designs can also be previewed within Linear.Automatic tracking with GitHub pull requestsLinear integrates with your pull requests. Just copy a Git branch name for an issue and start working.Once you open a pull request, Linear will automatically link the task to the pull request and change the issue status. On merge, the issue can automatically be closed.Support for other platforms will be added in the future.Get updates and create issues with SlackLinear is made to work with Slack, so you and your team can receive updates directly in your Slack channels.New issues can also be created in Slack. Linear will collect the context on the discussion and add it to the issue.Connect with 1000+ tools using ZapierCreate new issues based on triggers from Zapier applications.Custom workflows using our APIQuery and mutate data using our GraphQL API to build custom workflows.Keep the team focused and momentum up with CyclesTake iterative development to the next level with Cycles. Set your team’s weekly priorities and let Linear run the schedule.Velocity and estimates. Track your team's velocity, progress, and workload with the cycle chart.One-click standup. Focus on each team member with one click and see what they’ve completed and what they’re working on next.Automated schedule. Cycles automatically run on a schedule, and you can plan ahead by adding items to future cycles.Elevate your perspective with ProjectsProjects lets you group issues and get a birds-eye view of the progress your team is making.Organize. Add issues to projects to group them under one umbrella.Monitor progress.
